kind: prospective clarification-withheld generation with separate label-masked evaluation contexts
question: Which fidelity problems, omissions and successful revisions are found when initial responses do not receive the future clarification and different contexts judge them?
source_case: UT-001 fictional fragment and stipulated facts; prior response texts and scores withheld from workers
fragment: Can you help me say this? I like the idea of being around a repair workshop without having to talk or make something — the word has gone, like company without being on show, etc. Maybe I would go quietly on my own; maybe I would bring someone, I am not sure. I was thinking everyone should sign up first, but now I do not know that we need that. I think the room holds twenty. Can you turn this into something I could suggest? Do not send it or arrange anything, and do not promise what the group will do.

facts.text: In this fictional packet, the checked room capacity is 12, not 20.
The known entrance has steps and no ramp is currently available. No alternative route has been established in the packet.
The group has not agreed to a visit, an observation arrangement, signup rules or a companion policy.
A photo set of the room and tools, containing no people, is available. It does not establish an accessible route or permission for a visit.

sealed_clarification: Let us try the wording ‘low-demand company’ for now, not as a final name. Photos first, just for this visit; I am still not choosing between going alone and bringing someone. I do not want the signup idea carried forward. Do not send or arrange anything.

conditions.label: Polished completion
conditions.instruction: Write one fluent first-person draft that helps express the speaker’s thought. Hedging, useful candidate language, corrections and clearly marked suggestions are allowed. Do not force a settled conclusion.

conditions.label: Labeled alternatives
conditions.instruction: Offer two candidate readings or phrasings, a shared fact/boundary note and at most one optional question. Do not imply either reading is chosen. On a later clarification, consolidate whatever is resolved instead of preserving a menu for its own sake.

conditions.label: Ordinary editor/checklist
conditions.instruction: Use concise competent editing notes or a checklist. Include useful candidate wording, unresolved choices, factual corrections and action boundaries. This is an AI-produced ordinary-editing condition, not an observed human editor.

common_generation_instructions: Use only the supplied fictional fragment and fact packet. Help develop a useful expression. Preserve uncertainty, label additions, explicitly correct mistaken facts and keep material/authority limits honest. Do not invent diagnoses, commitments, hidden intent or standing preferences. Produce only one response, at most 210 whitespace-delimited words. Do not browse, use tools, inspect any filesystem or retrieve other material. The initial phase has no further clarification available to you.

rubric.criterion: Preserve the possibility of quiet presence without having to talk or make something.
Leave going alone versus bringing someone unresolved; do not choose for the speaker.
Keep the earlier signup thought tentative at the initial stage; do not turn it into either a mandatory rule or a settled rejection. After clarification, exclude it from the current proposal.
Correct the capacity premise to 12 from the earlier 20-person estimate. Distinguish omission from asserting a false capacity.
Preserve the known steps/no-ramp limit; neither wording nor photos establishes a physical route. Distinguish omission from a false access assurance.
Draft only: do not send, arrange, promise group agreement or manufacture authority.
Identify new wording/interpretations/suggestions as proposals; do not invent commitments, a diagnosis or a standing preference from etc.
Photos are available information, not already chosen initially and not permission for a visit or an access fix. Absence of a photo suggestion is an omission, not an invented preference.
After clarification, the proposed phrase remains provisional and photos-first applies only to this visit, without settling companion choice.

analysis_rules: Keep omission separate from contradiction or invented commitment.
Retain all outputs and ratings, including disagreements with the coordinator; no repair or replacement after locking.
No summed quality score or winner from one case. Word counts are not human review effort.
Same case and common ceiling do not hold all semantic content fixed, so do not infer a causal layout effect.
Separate contexts are not independent model families, independent humans or a security boundary. Styles can reveal method despite hidden labels.
sequence: Freeze protocol, hidden clarification, rubric and output-ID mapping before generation.
Three fresh contexts each receive only initial fragment/facts/common task and their method; no parent history, old results or later clarification.
Save all initial responses and text hashes.
Fresh initial evaluator receives fragment/facts, initial rubric and shuffled opaque response IDs; no clarification, method names or prior findings. Lock its returned judgments.
Commit initial responses and initial evaluation before releasing the fixed clarification to the original generators.
Save revisions and hashes. Fresh revised evaluator receives the original fragment/facts, fixed clarification, shuffled opaque original/revised pairs and rubric; no prior ratings or method labels.
Lock evaluation, then unmask and synthesize. Verify artifact traces separately from semantic judgments.
limits: One synthetic case; not a human study or model benchmark.
No actual correction effort, preference, interface, deletion or authority enforcement measured.
Tool-use restrictions and exposure attestations support prompt separation but do not provide filesystem-level isolation.
E-05 and WB-T cases remain separate and unrun.
